tool_input.command:
sed -n '1,260p' src/session.js && printf '
--- package ---
' && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && printf '
--- readme ---
' && sed -n '1,260p' README.md && printf '
--- node ---
' && /runtime/node --version

/runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import {Session} from './src/session.js'; let calls=0; const host={queryFn:({signal})=>{calls++; if(!signal || signal.aborted) throw Error('bad signal'); return 'stop';},timers:{schedule:fn=>fn()}}; const s=new Session(host,{online:false}); const h=s.subscribe('central'); if(s.snapshot('central').fetchStatus!=='paused') throw Error('not paused'); s.unsubscribe(h); if(s.snapshot('central').fetchStatus!=='idle') throw Error('orphan was not made idle'); s.online(true); await Promise.resolve(); if(calls) throw Error('orphan query invoked after reconnect'); const h2=s.subscribe('central'); if(calls!==1) throw Error('resubscribe did not start'); await Promise.resolve(); if(s.snapshot('central').data!=='stop') throw Error('resubscribe result missing'); console.log('offline orphan lifecycle ok');" && /runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import {Session} from './src/session.js'; let finish; let calls=0; const host={queryFn:()=>{calls++; return new Promise(resolve=>finish=resolve);},timers:{schedule:fn=>fn()}}; const s=new Session(host); const h=s.subscribe('central'); s.unsubscribe(h); finish('cached stop'); await Promise.resolve(); if(calls!==1 || s.snapshot('central').data!=='cached stop') throw Error('unconsumed started work did not complete'); console.log('unconsumed active completion ok');" && git diff --check && git diff -- src/session.js

/runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import {Session} from './src/session.js'; let calls=0; const host={queryFn:({signal})=>{calls++; void signal; return 'x';},timers:{schedule:fn=>fn()}}; const s=new Session(host,{online:false}); const h=s.subscribe('a'); s.online(true); s.unsubscribe(h); await Promise.resolve(); if(calls || s.snapshot('a').fetchStatus!=='idle') throw Error('queued resume escaped orphan cancellation'); console.log('queued reconnect race ok');" && /runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import {Session} from './src/session.js'; let calls=0; const host={queryFn:()=>{calls++; return 'refresh';},timers:{schedule:fn=>fn()}}; const s=new Session(host,{online:false}); const h=s.subscribe('a',{initialData:'old'}); s.unsubscribe(h); s.online(true); await Promise.resolve(); if(calls!==1 || s.snapshot('a').data!=='refresh') throw Error('cached paused refresh changed'); console.log('cached paused refresh ok');" && /runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import {Session} from './src/session.js'; let resolve; let calls=0; const host={queryFn:()=>{calls++; return new Promise(r=>resolve=r);},timers:{schedule:fn=>fn()}}; const s=new Session(host); const h1=s.subscribe('a'); const h2=s.subscribe('a'); s.unsubscribe(h1); if(calls!==1) throw Error('observers did not share attempt'); s.unsubscribe(h2); resolve('done'); await Promise.resolve(); if(s.snapshot('a').data!=='done') throw Error('shared unconsumed attempt cancelled'); console.log('multi-observer sharing ok');" && /runtime/node --check src/session.js

/runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import {Session} from './src/session.js'; let calls=0; const host={queryFn:()=>{calls++; return 'refresh';},timers:{schedule:fn=>fn()}}; const s=new Session(host,{online:false}); const h=s.subscribe('a',{initialData:'old'}); s.unsubscribe(h); s.online(true); await Promise.resolve(); await Promise.resolve(); if(calls!==1 || s.snapshot('a').data!=='refresh') throw Error('cached paused refresh changed'); console.log('cached paused refresh ok');" && /runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import {Session} from './src/session.js'; let resolve; let calls=0; const host={queryFn:()=>{calls++; return new Promise(r=>resolve=r);},timers:{schedule:fn=>fn()}}; const s=new Session(host); const h1=s.subscribe('a'); const h2=s.subscribe('a'); s.unsubscribe(h1); if(calls!==1) throw Error('observers did not share attempt'); s.unsubscribe(h2); resolve('done'); await Promise.resolve(); if(s.snapshot('a').data!=='done') throw Error('shared unconsumed attempt cancelled'); console.log('multi-observer sharing ok');" && /runtime/node --check src/session.js && sed -n '1,120p' src/session.js
